summary: Planet Green Holdings Corp. filed an 8-K on October 2, 2026 disclosing an ATM Sales Agreement with Craft Capital Management LLC as sales agent for up to approximately $22,539,922 of common stock under Form S-3 General Instruction I.B.6, capped at one-third of public float. Public float was about $67.6 million based on 11,638,514 non-affiliate shares at $5.81, the August 11, 2026 close. Sales occur at-the-market on NYSE American at the company's discretion with no stated price or timing. This ordinary shelf takedown facility is not a special situation; watch dilution and float overhang.
